meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 当消息里有附件时,Claude 会读取它在本地容器中的路径,通过 AnyDoc 工具转成本地 Markdown 文件,然后返回输出文件的路径;不会把文档上传到外部解析器。
howto.when: 当消息给出本地附件的文件路径,需要将文档内容转为 Markdown 而不上传到外部解析器时,此技能会被触发。

say.text: 把这条消息的 Word 附件转成 markdown,不要上传外部。
say.note: 会在容器内本地转换并返回 .md 文件。

say.text: 读取附带的 PDF 文件,转成 markdown 格式。
say.note: PDF 需为文本型,扫描件不支持。

say.text: 把这个 CSV 附件转成 markdown 并列出内容。
say.note: CSV 会按 stdin 方式显式指定格式转换。

howto.what_en: When an attachment is in the message, Claude reads its local container path, converts the document into a local Markdown file with the AnyDoc tool, and returns the output path; the document is not uploaded to an external parser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the message supplies a local attachment path and the document must be converted to Markdown without uploading to an external parser.

say_en.text: Convert this Word attachment to markdown, don't upload it externally.
say_en.note: Converted locally in the container and returns the .md file.

say_en.text: Read the attached PDF and turn it into markdown.
say_en.note: Must be text-based PDF; scanned images are not supported.

say_en.text: Convert this CSV attachment to markdown and list its content.
say_en.note: CSV will be read from stdin with explicit format.
